query: Which missing-data mechanism (MCAR, MAR, MNAR) best fits each data stream (survey, RS, lab), and what diagnostics will you use to justify that classification?

response.query: Which missing-data mechanism (MCAR, MAR, MNAR) best fits each data stream (survey, RS, lab), and what diagnostics will you use to justify that classification?
response.answer: Survey data often follows MAR; lab data can be MCAR; RS data typically MNAR. Diagnostics include Little's MCAR test and MAR analysis.
